mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The rank correlation (IC) between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not negative (i.e., IC <= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% is not negative (i.e., average return >= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 2.5% (annualized), it indicates a monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rising
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is rising is not negative (i.e., average return >= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1300), the S&P 500 predicts negative forward returns due to overvaluation and impending policy tightening over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when HOUST exceeds 1300 is not negative (i.e., average return >= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, supporting equity valuations and resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The rank correlation (IC) between INDPRO and 60-day forward returns is not positive (i.e., IC <= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation prompting central bank tightening that reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 2.5% is not negative (i.e., average return >= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 350,000, it indicates strong consumer demand supporting corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 350000 is not positive (i.e., average return <= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with lower economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The rank correlation (IC) between UNRATE and 5-day forward returns is not negative (i.e., IC >= 0) over any 3-year rolling window.
